ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method and reverse the no-show charge to the driver; record the cancellation as driver-initiated (vehicle defect) and remind the driver that no-show fees apply only to genuine rider no-shows.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, driver statement, chat logs and app events contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing to escalate under SAFE-1/SAFE-2.

Characterising the cancellation (NS-0): who cancelled is a system record — the trip data show cancelled_by = driver, and the driver's own words ("my tyre went flat, so I had to cancel") match his chat message at 22:41:25. The app reason he selected (no-show) is only his claim; his own statement and message give a different reason, so this is a driver cancellation "for another reason" → NS-3, not NS-1.

NS-1 conditions fail in any event: (i) arrival is in the record ("driver_arrived" 22:35:45, GPS at 1.37336/103.89355 within ~60 m of the pickup 1.37301/103.89344 — inside the 200 m radius), (ii) the free wait: later of scheduled pickup and 22:35:45 arrival, so 5 min runs to ≈22:40:45 — the driver in fact stayed until 22:41:35, (iii) the driver sent a chat message at 22:36:15 and one in-app call at 22:37:15, but the call was NOT answered (answered = false, duration 0 s) — an unanswered call cannot serve as the call required by NS-1(iii)/§2.3, and (iv) presence is proven, no GPS gap. The rider was never told to come out and the driver cancelled for his own car problem, so no no-show fee can stand.

Amount: NS-3 → no fee; if charged, refund_full. The charged item is the $5.00 cancellation fee, refunded in full to the original payment method. A no-show-fee charge under a false no-show reason is also abuse the policy treats as voidable, but no flag is warranted here: the driver has one upheld no-show in the last 90 days, and RD-6/NS-9 flagging is not triggered by this record.

Precedents: DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00 refunded) is aligned; the rider's clean record (0 disputes in 90 days) and the driver's self-contradiction support the outcome. Amount is under $10 → system ruling final (TH-1, TH-2).

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0: NS-1/NS-2 vs NS-3)
element_findings.reason: Trip data record cancelled_by = driver; the driver's chat at 22:41:25 and his statement both give a vehicle defect (tyre puncture) as the reason, not a rider no-show. The app-selected no-show reason is only his claim and is contradicted by his own words, so the cancellation falls under NS-3 (other reason).

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived at pickup (I'm Here / auto-confirm + GPS within 200 m)
element_findings.reason: app_events show driver_arrived at 22:35:45 and GPS samples from 22:36:00 sit at 1.37336/103.89355, about 60 m from the pickup point 1.37301/103.89344.

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed from later of scheduled pickup and arrival
element_findings.reason: Arrival 22:35:45 + 5 min = 22:40:45; driver stayed until cancellation at 22:41:35, so the wait period had elapsed (no record no-show threshold applies).

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) before cancelling, driver sent >=1 in-app message AND made >=1 in-app call
element_findings.reason: One chat message sent 22:36:15, but the single in-app call at 22:37:15 was unanswered (answered = false, duration 0 s, no recording/transcript). An unanswered call does not satisfy the 'AND ... at least 1 phone call' requirement, so the condition fails and the fee is void under NS-2.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: GPS samples every 30 s from 22:36:00 to 22:41:35 remain within a few metres of the pickup point; no gap in the track.
No chat message, complaint or statement describes a threat, harassment, sexual remark, accident, injury or dangerous driving; nothing requiring escalation.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's own chat and statement attribute the cancellation to a flat tyre, not to a rider no-show; the trip record shows cancelled_by = driver, so the no-show fee basis (NS-1) is not established.
The in-app call at 22:37:15 was unanswered (answered = false, 0 s), so it cannot serve as the required call under NS-1(iii)/O1 §2.3.
